editorial:
You follow Percy, a teen who keeps getting into trouble, until he learns he is Poseidon's son and Zeus's stolen lightning could spark a god war. With friends Annabeth and Grover, he heads on a road trip full of monsters, magic, and big surprises. The vibe is energetic and family-friendly, mixing modern teen humor with Greek myths in a way that feels easy to enjoy.

The action moves quickly, with sword fights, creature battles, and a fun quest across America. Logan Lerman gives Percy a likable, awkward charm, while the supporting cast keeps things lively. Some fans of the books may miss details, but the movie still works as a fast, light adventure. The pacing rarely slows, so younger viewers can stay engaged without feeling lost. If you want a fun fantasy night, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Percy reaches the Underworld and learns Hades did not steal Zeus's lightning. The real thief is Luke, who wants to start a war among the gods. Percy returns the lightning to Zeus, stopping the conflict. He also rescues his mother and accepts his place among the gods, while Luke escapes to continue his plan. Percy chooses to stay at Camp Half-Blood with his friends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves adventure, fantasy, and family-friendly action.
